_about: Controlled vocabulary for file names. Single source for Python (python/labnaming.py) and MATLAB (matlab/lab_filename.m). Edited only by the data steward. Long-term this is generated from the vocab_* tables in lab.db.

legacy_eye_map._about: Old pl2_to_mat.m names used LE/RE. Map them to the canonical codes; never write LE/RE in new names.
